children: Fifth Third Bancorp announced redemption of $500 million of 1.707% senior notes, to be redeemed Nov. 1, 2026 at principal plus accrued interest.
Delivered redemption notice for all outstanding 1.707% Fixed/Floating Senior Notes due 2027 (CUSIP 316773 DD9).
Principal amount to be redeemed: $500 million; redemption price equals principal plus accrued interest to Nov 1, 2026.
Redemption is one year prior to scheduled maturity (Nov 1, 2027); no 2021 Notes will remain outstanding after redemption.
Payment due on redemption date upon presentation and surrender of notes; interest ceases to accrue on and after Nov 1, 2026.
